capabilities: add custom callbacks to a single save command
rebind the save hotkey to the custom save command
configure callbacks in the plugin settings tab
extras: Not yet in the community plugin store; install via BRAT or manually. Author solicits GitHub Sponsors and Buy Me a Coffee support.
problem: Obsidian's save action is fixed, so users cannot run extra actions automatically each time they save a note.
summary: Save command that lets you attach multiple custom callbacks that run when you save via a hotkey.
